authority.rule: Drive owns engineering/evidence content. Git is a typed implementation mirror and cannot raise an evidence ceiling.

transition_rules.UNBOUND_to_SOURCE_BOUND: Require an attributable source or measured reference. Do not infer missing commercial geometry/material/rating data from the archetype.
transition_rules.SOURCE_BOUND_to_GEOMETRY_BOUND: Bind exact package/CAD/BREP/measurement geometry and revision, including interfaces and tolerances.
transition_rules.GEOMETRY_BOUND_to_MATERIAL_BOUND: Bind actual materials/lots/passports and interface/new-neutral layers. Generic archetype material lists are not sufficient.
transition_rules.MATERIAL_BOUND_to_PROCESS_BOUND: Bind the directional manufacturing/assembly sequence, atmosphere/temperature/post-process state and damage checks.
transition_rules.PROCESS_BOUND_to_TEST_DEFINED: Define acceptance tests, instrumentation/calibration, falsifiers and failure modes before build.
transition_rules.TEST_DEFINED_to_BUILD_READY: Pass safety, authority, evidence, manufacturability and tool-capability gates; all hard unknowns remain explicit.
transition_rules.BUILD_READY_to_BUILT: Record exact configuration/source hashes and execution receipt. Build state alone is not qualification.
transition_rules.BUILT_to_MEASURED: Read back physical measurements with uncertainty and calibration provenance.
transition_rules.MEASURED_to_REVIEWED_PROMOTION: Review against the same declared baseline/objective and preserve the lowest applicable evidence ceiling.

raphael_comparison_contract.rule: Raphael is comparative/supervisory, not a substitute for conventional physical law.
raphael_comparison_contract.baseline: Use the conventional/current geometry under the same material, environment, boundary conditions and objective wherever physically meaningful.
raphael_comparison_contract.candidate: Vary only declared geometry/topology/placement/nesting/interface variables inside measured manufacturing capability.
raphael_comparison_contract.solver_order: Conventional physics solver first, Raphael residual/comparison second.
raphael_comparison_contract.reporting: Report per-metric signed deltas, uncertainty, constraint state and Pareto status; never collapse hard safety/evidence/authority failures into a composite score.
raphael_comparison_contract.promotion: A candidate is not an improvement until empirical comparison survives the declared acceptance and falsification tests.

hard_boundaries: Archetype evidence is not an exact-part datasheet, material certificate, process qualification or product certification.
Advanced silicon, MEMS, quartz/SAW/BAW, precision optoelectronics and certified protection remain seed/hybrid unless their complete local process chain is separately qualified.
Certified or safety-rated seed components retain their own authority; printed surrounding geometry cannot inherit the rating.
Ambient electromagnetic harvesting is limited by measured incident spectrum/flux, coupling/effective aperture, matching, conversion loss, storage loss and load duty cycle.
Frequency/resonance coincidence does not establish biological or health benefit.
High-voltage, mains, pressure, reactive chemistry, ecological release and mission hardware require their existing specialist/owner gates.
Physical execution must be explicit; DIGITAL_CONTRACT or BUILD_READY never means a coupon/device was physically produced or tested.
